import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/training_2.csv"
]

# Target schema columns and their types
target_columns = [
    'fixed acidity', 'volatile acidity', 'citric acid', 'residual sugar', 'chlorides',
    'free sulfur dioxide', 'total sulfur dioxide', 'density', 'pH', 'sulphates',
    'alcohol', 'quality'
]

target_dtypes = {
    'fixed acidity': float,
    'volatile acidity': float,
    'citric acid': float,
    'residual sugar': float,
    'chlorides': float,
    'free sulfur dioxide': int,
    'total sulfur dioxide': int,
    'density': float,
    'pH': float,
    'sulphates': float,
    'alcohol': float,
    'quality': int
}

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target columns (all sources have same schema)
    # If any extra columns exist, drop them; if any missing, raise error
    df = df[target_columns]
    
    # Enforce correct dtypes for each column
    for col, dtype in target_dtypes.items():
        # For integer columns, convert safely (some may be float in source)
        if dtype == int:
            # Convert to int by rounding or truncation if needed
            # Here we convert via astype after filling NaNs if any
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
        else:
            df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target,
# we can concatenate (union) all source tables vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Final check: ensure target_df columns and dtypes match exactly target schema
target_df = target_df[target_columns]
for col, dtype in target_dtypes.items():
    if dtype == int:
        target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(int)
    else:
        target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(dtype)

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
